{{2021–22 Horizon League men's basketball standings}}
The '''2021–22 Milwaukee Panthers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Wisconsin–Milwaukee]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Panthers, led by fifth-year head coach [[Pat Baldwin (basketball)|Pat Baldwin]], played their home games at the [[UW–Milwaukee Panther Arena]] in [[Milwaukee]], Wisconsin as members of the [[Horizon League]].

They finished the season 10–21, 8–14 in [[2021–22 Horizon League men's basketball season|Horizon League play]], to finish in ninth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2022 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]] to [[2021–22 UIC Flames men's basketball team|UIC]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zills |first=Chris |date=2022-03-01 |title=Comeback Down The Stretch Falls Short Against UIC |url=https://mkepanthers.com/news/2022/3/1/mens-basketball-comeback-down-the-stretch-falls-short-against-uic.aspx |access-date=2025-08-05 |website=Milwaukee Athletics |language=en}}</ref>

On March 2, 2022, the school fired head coach Pat Baldwin.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-02 |title=UW-Milwaukee fires coach Pat Baldwin after 5 losing seasons |url=https://fox11online.com/sports/college/university-of-wisconsin-milwaukee-panthers-mens-basketball-fires-coach-pat-baldwin-after-5-losing-seasons |access-date=2022-03-30 |website=fox11online.com |language=en |agency=The Associated Press}}</ref> On March 19, the school named [[NCAA Division II|Division II]] [[Queens University of Charlotte|Queens University]] head coach [[Bart Lundy]] the team's new head coach.

==Previous season==
In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Milwaukee Panthers men's basketball team|Panthers]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 10–12, 7–10 in Horizon League play, to finish in eighth place. In the [[2021 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball team|IUPUI]] in the first round<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zills |first=Chris |date=2021-02-25 |title=Big First Half Sets Up Panthers For 84-72 Victory Over IUPUI |url=https://mkepanthers.com/news/2021/2/25/mens-basketball-big-first-half-sets-up-panthers-for-84-72-victory-over-iupui.aspx |access-date=2025-08-05 |website=Milwaukee Athletics |language=en}}</ref> and [[2020–21 Wright State Raiders men's basketball team|Wright State]] in the quarterfinals,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zills |first=Chris |date=2021-03-02 |title=COMEBACK KIDS DO IT AGAIN, TOP RAIDERS IN OT! |url=https://mkepanthers.com/news/2021/3/2/mens-basketball-comeback-kids-do-it-again-top-raiders-in-ot.aspx |access-date=2025-08-05 |website=Milwaukee Athletics |language=en}}</ref> before losing to [[2020–21 Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team|Cleveland State]] in the semifinals.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zills |first=Chris |date=2021-03-08 |title=Late Cleveland State Rally Derails Milwaukee Upset |url=https://mkepanthers.com/news/2021/3/8/mens-basketball-late-cleveland-state-rally-derails-milwaukee-upset.aspx |access-date=2025-08-05 |website=Milwaukee Athletics |language=en}}</ref>

==Preseason==
The Panthers were picked to finish in fourth place in the [[Horizon League]] in the coaches' poll, receiving two first-place votes and a total of 396 points. [[Patrick Baldwin Jr.]] was selected to the Preseason First Team All-Horizon League, while DeAndre Gholston was selected to the Preseason Second Team All-Horizon League.<ref>{{cite web |title=CLEVELAND STATE NAMED #HLMBB FAVORITE, DETROIT MERCY’S DAVIS TABBED PRESEASON PLAYER OF THE YEAR |url=https://horizonleague.org/news/2021/10/18/mens-basketball-cleveland-state-named-hlmbb-favorite-detroit-mercys-davis-tabbed-preseason-player-of-the-year.aspx |website=[[Horizon League]] |access-date=October 29, 2021 |date=October 19, 2021}}</ref>
